notes.title: Achievements!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I am happy to say that I have figured out how to add achievements to most of the games! Whenever you earn them and quit the launched game, they will show up in the launcher!

The reason I have them for most games is because some games (Room Service, Gavin's Wonderhouse, and Passageways Dev Version) are either just small easy games or, in Passageways Dev Version's case, the literal exact same game.

Happy Achievement hunting!

Best Regards,
Gavin Tyler
